item.text:
**7B.5 Research Note**

Bottom line: mostly yes. The 2024 record points to Scholz putting experienced administrators and technocrats in key posts, not family members, donors, or obvious cronies. The main counterweight is that one of the most important replacements, Jörg Kukies, was also a close Scholz adviser, so there is an inner-circle/loyalty element. I found no reliable 2024 evidence of family or donor patronage.

- [BMF-Monatsbericht November 2024 - Im Interview](https://www.bundesfinanzministerium.de/Monatsberichte/Ausgabe/2024/11/Kapitel/kapitel-2-interview.html) · Bundesfinanzministerium · 21 Nov 2024 · Kukies describes a long technocratic career: prior BMF state secretary, later Chancellery lead on economic/financial/climate and European policy, G7/G20 sherpa, plus economics training and investment-banking experience. This is strong evidence of a competence-first appointment. Question IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`.

- [Entlassung und Ernennung von Ministerinnen und Ministern der Bundesregierung](https://www.bundespraesident.de/SharedDocs/Termine/DE/Frank-Walter-Steinmeier/2024/11/241107-Entlassungen-Ernennung-Minister.html) · Bundespräsident · 7 Nov 2024 · Steinmeier appointed Kukies on Scholz’s proposal after the Lindner dismissal under Article 64. That is a formal constitutional staffing process, not an informal patronage move. Question IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.3`.

- [Jörg Kukies zum Finanzminister vereidigt](https://www.bundestag.de/dokumente/textarchiv/2024/kw45-de-eidesleistung-1028648) · Deutscher Bundestag · 7 Nov 2024 · The Bundestag notes Kukies’s oath and his prior service as a finance-ministry and Chancellery state secretary. This supports the view that Scholz turned to an experienced civil servant rather than a family, donor, or pure loyalist pick. Question IDs: `7B.5`.

- [As head of government on borrowed time, Scholz appoints close adviser to Finance Ministry](https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/11/08/as-head-of-government-on-borrowed-time-scholz-appoints-close-adviser-to-finance-ministry_6732062_4.html) · Le Monde · 8 Nov 2024 · The main cautionary note is that Scholz chose a close economic adviser for the finance post. That suggests trust and personal proximity mattered, but the source still describes Kukies as a capable technocrat rather than an unqualified crony. Question IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`.

- [The 2024 lobby-register changes expanded disclosure](https://www.bundestag.de/parlament/lobbyregister/pm-240301-nl-992030) · Deutscher Bundestag · 1 Mar 2024 · Parliament broadened disclosure on rulemaking, financing sources, and revolving-door ties. That is evidence of an anti-capture environment, which cuts against hidden patronage networks. Question IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`.

- [The cabinet adopted executive-footprint / synopsis changes](https://www.bundesregierung.de/breg-de/aktuelles/bundeskabinett-ergebnisse-2263572) · Bundesregierung · 6 Mar 2024 · The government improved traceability of draft laws and outside influence. This is a concrete transparency reform and weakens the case for opaque staffing or backroom control. Question IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`, `7B.2`.

- [Government resolves AI Act dispute and moves toward compromise](https://www.investing.com/news/economy/germany-will-approve-eus-planned-ai-act--sources-3286730) · Reuters via Investing.com · 30 Jan 2024 · Reuters reported the coalition settled its internal dispute and moved toward a “trustworthy AI” compromise. That is not staffing evidence, but it does show rule-based, expert-driven policymaking rather than a patronage style. Question IDs: `7B.5`, `7B.4`.

**Search gap**

I did not find reliable 2024 evidence that Scholz appointed family members, donors, business associates, or obvious yes-men to office. The negative side is limited to inner-circle selection and some transparency concerns, not proven nepotism or self-dealing staffing.
